description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseInteractionsAPIConfig' for configuring and transforming requests and responses for the Google Interactions API within the litellm project. It includes method signatures for request transformation, response processing, and handling various interaction types (create, get, delete, cancel), as well as external references and type annotations relevant to the interactions API.

classes.name: BaseInteractionsAPIConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class providing the interface and partial implementation for configuring and transforming API calls for Google Interactions API. It defines methods for request transformation, response handling, URL construction, and error handling, which must be implemented by subclasses.
